failureModes: primary AI_400 credit exhaustion propagated without checking existing approved fallback governance
a successful cron trigger was misleading without a provider-verified predictive outcome
an unrestricted fallback could leak prohibited raw private content

sanitize to public-news and search-demand signals; exclude raw private payloads, DMs, contact data, credentials and non-approved sources
strictly validate JSON forecast structure, approved evidence keys and numerical limits before existing predictive write gates
persist real provider, model and reason in the canonical forecast and same-day health receipt; never mark a failed model as successful
